name: browser-use
headline: Claude Code SDK TS - fluent TypeScript integration
short_description: Fluent, chainable TypeScript SDK: configure models, enable tools, stream events, then fetch text, JSON, run details or token stats in one call via .asText() or .allowTools('Read', 'Write'). Multi-level logging plus live onMessage/onToolUse callbacks give deep, CLI-compatible observability.
author: instantlyeasy

sections.overview:
The Claude Code SDK for TypeScript is an unofficial SDK that provides a fluent, chainable API for interacting with Claude Code CLI. It enables developers to configure AI models, manage tool permissions (Read, Write, Bash, Grep, LS), handle sessions with context retention, and stream responses with fine-grained observability. The SDK supports multiple response formats including plain text, JSON, and tool execution analysis, plus advanced features like cancellation support, error handling with typed categories, and comprehensive logging. Ideal for developers building automation workflows, code analysis tools, or integrations that need programmatic control over Claude's capabilities.
Automate code refactoring and analysis workflows with permission control
Build CI/CD integrations that query Claude with specific tool access
Create multi-turn sessions that maintain conversation context
Parse Claude's JSON responses for structured data extraction
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/instantlyeasy/claude-code-sdk-ts`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
